checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: All clutter removed from counters, sink and stove.

must.item: Brown cabinets and beige tiles remain
must.why: Cabinets and tiles preserved; counter looks slightly cleaner/whiter but not renovated.
Same angle and layout; faucets, outlets and sink match. Stove burners became flat plates, a minor change.
Counters look smooth with no visible remnants; the right stove area is slightly smoothed and the faucet is lost.

faults.what: Right-hand sink basin turned into a flat stove-like surface and its tap seems gone; the fixture changed.
Counter edge and backsplash are slightly smoothed or whitened, with soft AI texture and low resolution.
A pale wall-mounted object on the right side of the window area was altered.

summary: The kitchen is clearly decluttered with cabinets, tiles and layout kept, but the right sink basin and tap were altered into a flat panel.
